title: Protocol for functional characterization of endoreduplicated murine trophoblast cells
protocol: Thaw a frozen vial of murine TSC in a 37°C water bath.
Transfer the contents of the vial gently onto a 15 mL sterile centrifuge tube containing 5 mL TS complete media.
Centrifuge at 200 × g for 5 min.
Aspirate the media to remove the DMSO containing freezing media completely.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 5 mL TSC maintenance media and maintain the cells at 37°C in a humidified incubator supplied with 5% CO2 for 48 hours.
Perform rapid cell thawing to ensure maximum viability of TSCs.
Remove all DMSO from the freezing media during the thawing procedure.
Wash the cell monolayer with sterile DPBS to remove traces of FBS.
Incubate TSCs with 0.05% Trypsin-EDTA to cover the entire surface for 30 seconds at 37°C in an incubator.
Neutralize the cells with double amount of TS complete media.
Mix the cell suspension gently and transfer to a 15 mL centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge the mixture at 200 × g for 5 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant, resuspend the pellet in TSC maintenance media.
Subculture the cells at a ratio of 1:3.
Mix properly after adding mitogens such that FGF4 and heparin are distributed homogenously in the media.
Do not allow the cells to grow beyond 65% confluence as this might result in spontaneous differentiation.
Use cells up to passage 22 for experimental purposes.
Avoid trypsinization for more than five minutes to prevent loss of surface receptors.
Obtain a pellet of TSCs.
Wash the cell pellet with 5 mL sterile DPBS to remove traces of mitogens.
Resuspend the cells in TS complete media.
Plate the resuspended cells at a density of 60,000 cells per T25 flask.
Maintain the plated cells for 6 consecutive days.
Replenish the media once on each of the first two days.
Replenish the media daily from the third day until the fifth day.
Harvest the cells on the 6th day of differentiation.
Aspirate the media from TSCs.
Wash the cell monolayer with sterile DPBS.
Add 1 mL of 0.05% Trypsin-EDTA per T25 flask and incubate at 37°C in an incubator.
Neutralize the action of trypsin with double the volume of TS complete media.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 15 mL centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 200 × g for 5 minutes.
Aspirate the trypsin-containing medium.
Wash the cells with 2 mL sterile DPBS.
Centrifuge at 200 × g for 5 minutes.
Discard the supernatant.
Dissolve the pellet in 1 mL TRIzol.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Aspirate the media and wash the cell monolayer with sterile DPBS.
Add 1 mL TRIzol to the cells and incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Scrape off the cell monolayer directly with a cell scraper.
Transfer 1 mL of lysed suspension into a RNase-free (DEPC treated) 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Incubate for 5 minutes to allow complete dissociation of nucleoprotein complexes.
Add 200 μL chloroform to the tube containing the lysate.
Mix very gently by inverting the tube in a "figure-of-eight" pattern.
Incubate for 3 min at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 12,000 × g for 15 min at 4°C.
Collect the aqueous phase containing the RNA into a fresh RNase-free tube.
Add 500 μL isopropanol to the collected aqueous phase.
Incubate for 10 min at 4°C.
Centrifuge at 12,000 × g for 10 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant completely.
Wash the RNA pellet with 1 mL of 75% ethanol at 7,500 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant completely.
Dissolve the RNA pellet in nuclease-free water by gentle pipetting.
Heat the RNA sample at 65°C for 5 min.
Quick chill on ice for 2 min.
Measure the quality and total amount of RNA spectrophotometrically by determining the 260/280 ratio and concentration respectively.
Use 5 μg RNA to reverse transcribe first-strand cDNA using oligo dT primers.
Prepare individual reverse transcription RNA mix as described in materials and equipment.
Heat the mix to 65°C for 5 min followed by a quick chilling on ice for 2 min.
Prepare the reverse transcription enzyme mix as described in materials and equipment.
Add 7 μL of the enzyme mix to each tube.
Mix gently.
Mix the contents of each tube thoroughly.
Incubate at 37°C for 2 minutes.
Add 1 μL (200 U) M-MLV RT and mix gently by pipetting up and down.
Incubate for 50 minutes at 37°C.
Heat inactivate the enzyme by incubating at 70°C for a specified duration.
Remove RNA present as hybrid with cDNA by adding 0.5 μL (1 U) of E.coli RNaseH and incubating at 37°C for 20 minutes.
Prepare a 10 μM sub-stock of individual 100 μM forward and reverse primers in low TE buffer.
Prepare a 1 μM primer mix containing both forward and reverse primers in low TE buffer.
Prepare a 1:10 dilution of cDNA by adding 1 μL cDNA to 9 μL nuclease-free water.
Prepare a qPCR mix containing 1 μL of 1:10 diluted cDNA, 5 μL FG-Power SYBR Green, 1 μL of 1 μM primer mix and 3 μL water.
Run the qPCR as per the cycle conditions mentioned below.
Analyze the Ct values of the target gene and the endogenous control (Rpl7).
Calculate the fold change using the 2–ΔΔCt method.
Grow TSCs at 60% confluency in T25 flask.
Aspirate the media from TSC cultures and wash the cell monolayer with sterile DPBS (pH 7.4).
Add 1 ml of 0.05% Trypsin-EDTA per T25 flask for TSCs.
Incubate at 37°C in an incubator for 30 s.
Neutralize trypsin action by adding double the volume of TS complete media to TSC suspension.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 15 ml centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 200 × g for 5 min.
Wash cells once with 1× sterile DPBS (pH 7.4) at 200 × g for 5 min.
Aspirate the media from TGC cultures and wash the cell monolayer with sterile DPBS (pH 7.4).
Add 1 ml of 0.25% Trypsin-EDTA per T25 flask for TGCs.
Incubate at 37°C in an incubator for 4 min.
Neutralize trypsin action by adding five times the volume of TS complete media to TGC suspension.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 15 ml centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 200 × g for 5 min.
Wash cells once with 1× sterile DPBS (pH 7.4) at 200 × g for 5 min.
Re-suspend the TGC pellet in 1 ml of DPBS (pH 7.4).
Count the cells using a hemocytometer.
Take 5 × 10^5 cells per analysis and transfer them to a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 200 × g for 5 min.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 100 μl of blocking buffer containing 0.5% donkey serum dissolved in 1× cell permeabilization buffer.
Incubate at 4°C for 30 min.
Centrifuge cells at 200 × g for 5 min.
Aspirate the supernatant completely.
Incubate cells in 100 μL of 1× cell permeabilization buffer containing primary antibodies specific to Cytokeratin and Prl2c2 at a dilution of 1:100 for approximately 1 h 30 min at 4°C.
Centrifuge cells at 200 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Wash cells three times in 500 μL DPBS (pH 7.4) by centrifuging at 200 × g for 5 min each time and aspirating the supernatant after each wash.

Incubate cell pellets in 100 μL of 1× cell permeabilization buffer containing fluorochrome-conjugated anti-mouse and anti-goat secondary antibodies at a dilution of 1:200 for Cytokeratin and Prl2c2, respectively, for 1 h 30 min at 4°C.
Centrifuge cells at 200 × g for 5 min after incubation.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Wash cell pellet twice with 500 μL of 1× DPBS (pH 7.4).
Resuspend cell pellet in 500 μL of 1× DPBS (pH 7.4).
Analyze cells in a flow-cytometer using appropriate filters for respective fluorochromes.
Incubate cells only with fluorochrome conjugated IgGs to compensate for background signal, under conditions identical to the stained samples.
Perform primary gating based on forward scatter and side scatter to exclude debris and dead cells.
Use fluorochromes with minimal spectral overlap for simultaneous detection of multiple markers.
Set fluorescence gates for markers based on unstained samples, isotype controls, and single stained controls.
Draw quadrants to quantitate individual cell populations based on their marker specificity.
Harvest TSCs by aspirating the media from the cells.
Wash the cell monolayer with sterile DPBS (pH 7.4).
Add 1 mL of 0.05% Trypsin-EDTA per T25 flask.
Incubate at 37°C in an incubator for 30 seconds.
Neutralize the action of trypsin with double the volume of TS complete media.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 15 mL centrifuge tube.
Aspirate the media and wash the cell monolayer with sterile DPBS.
Add 1 mL 0.25% Trypsin-EDTA per T25 flask.
Incubate at 37°C in an incubator for 4 min to completely dislodge the giant cells.
Neutralize the action of trypsin with five times the volume of TS complete media.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 15 mL centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 200 × g for 5 min.
Aspirate the trypsin containing media.
Wash the cell pellet once with sterile DPBS at 200 × g for 5 min.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 500 μL sterile DPBS and count the number of cells.
Prepare a 250 μL cell suspension having a concentration of 106 cells/mL.
Stain the nuclei with Hoechst33258 at a final concentration of 2 μg/mL.
Add 0.25 μL of 2 mg/mL Hoechst 33258 stock solution to 250 μL cell suspension.
Mix gently by pipetting up and down.
Incubate for 30 min at 37°C in an incubator.
Set the flow cytometer for ultraviolet excitation (340–380 nm).
Measure the cell fluorescence using pulse width vs pulse area signal to discriminate between G2 population and doublets.
Remove the media from the cells.
Fix the cells with freshly prepared 4% paraformaldehyde for 15 min at room temperature.
Wash the cells three times (5 min each) with 1 mL DPBS by gentle rotation.
Stain the F-actin filaments with DyLight™ 554 Phalloidin at a dilution of 1:200 in DPBS for 20 min at room temperature under complete darkness.
Wash the cells three times (5 min each) with 1 mL DPBS by gentle rotation.
Counterstain the nuclei with Hoechst 33258 at a final concentration of 2 μg/mL for 20 minutes at room temperature under complete darkness.
Wash the cells five times with 1 mL DPBS by gentle rotation, each wash lasting 5 minutes.
Mount the coverslips onto clean slides with Fluoroshield.
Allow it to dry and then seal the edges.
Set up the confocal microscope for 340 nm and 550 nm excitation to capture the fluorescence image of Hoechst 33258 and Phalloidin, respectively.
Open the Hoechst-stained image of the nuclei using ImageJ software.
Use the line selection tool to draw a line over the scale bar and use the software to measure it in pixels.
Initialize the software to establish a relationship between the provided distance of the scale bar (in μm) with an equivalent distance in pixels.
Smooth the image using Process/Smooth if the nuclei appear very crowded and touching each other.
Set the threshold of the image to an optimum value such that all nuclei appear as evenly highlighted regions.
Remove or enhance pixels from saturation based on the set threshold.
Select “overlay outlines” to outline the periphery/boundary of individual nuclei.
Optimize pixel size discrimination using boundary markings to eliminate artifacts.
Analyze and calculate the area of each nucleus by selecting Analyze/Analyze particles.
Export data regarding nuclear sizes to GraphPad Prism for statistical analysis.
Aspirate media and wash cell monolayer with sterile DPBS.
Add 1 mL of 0.05% Trypsin-EDTA per T25 flask and incubate at 37°C for 30 s.
Neutralize trypsin action with double the volume of TS complete media.
Transfer cell suspension to a 15 mL centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 200 × g for 5 min.
Aspirate the media from TGC cell monolayer.
Wash the cell monolayer with sterile DPBS.
Add 1 mL of 0.25% Trypsin-EDTA per T25 flask.
Incubate at 37°C for 4 min in an incubator to dislodge cells completely.
Neutralize trypsin action with five times the volume of TS complete media.
Transfer cell suspension to a 15 mL centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 200 × g for 5 min.
Aspirate supernatant and re-suspend cell pellet in 1 mL F-actin stabilization buffer (pH 6.9).
Pass the cell suspension repeatedly through a 25-gauge needle attached to a 5 mL syringe.
Incubate homogenate at 37°C for 10 min.
Centrifuge and pellet down cell debris at 326 × g for 5 min.
Collect supernatant.
Subject supernatant to immunoblot analysis.
Measure total amount of endogenous controls [rPL7 (1:5000), GAPDH (1:1000) and total β-actin (1:1000)].
Ultracentrifuge supernatant at 100,000 × g for 1 h using Sorvall WX Ultra Series centrifuge with T890 rotor.
Collect the supernatant as the G-actin fraction and concentrate it with a 10 kD cut-off centrifugal-filter unit by centrifuging at 4,000 × g for 10 min.
Re-suspend cell pellet (F-actin fraction) in equal volume of F-actin de-polymerization buffer (pH 6.9).
Incubate re-suspended cells at 4°C for 1 h.
Mix equal volumes of individual fractions in TSCs and TGCs.
Probe the blots with Pan-actin antibody at a dilution of 1:1000.
